page_updates.snippet: July 31 midday update: the ferry-L lift is out of service; the ferry is not step-free until repaired. The step-free bus-L remains available.

hidden_tools.name: festival_search
hidden_tools.usage: Harbour Festival search. Argument: query (optional string), e.g. "Pancho Libre" or "bus route". Returns current show listings, routes and access offers; rows can appear, change or disappear, so re-check before reserving.

entries.title: Pancho Libre - 20:00 Pier (prior year)
entries.text: A 2026 listing showing a 20:00 Pier set at 189 CAD for the party. Prior-year paid ticket listings are stale: this year's festival admission is free.

entries.title: Pancho Libre - 21:00 Maritime Museum (pending)
entries.text: This year's 21:00 set at the Maritime Museum, awaiting official confirmation from the festival access desk.

entries.title: Pancho Libre - 18:00 Maritime Museum
entries.text: Same artist and stage at 18:00: not the requested 21:00 set.

entries.title: Seb and Fritz - 20:00 Sackville
entries.text: A different artist at 20:00 on the Sackville stage.

entries.title: Family Act - 14:00 Seaport
entries.text: Free daytime family show at 14:00 on the Seaport stage; the walk from the headline stage is 18 minutes, beyond the family's limit.

entries.title: Fireworks - 22:00 Harbour
entries.text: Harbour fireworks at 22:00: too late for the 22:15 home deadline.

entries.title: Accessible bus-L round trip
entries.text: Step-free accessible bus: outbound 20:00-20:20 with an eight-minute step-free walk to the viewing area, standing stretches at most seven minutes; return walk 21:35-21:43, bus 21:50, arrive 22:10, five-minute walk home (home by 22:15). Roundtrip family fare 18 CAD. Platform opens 20:30; the 20:28 arrival waits two minutes.

entries.title: Ferry-L round trip
entries.text: Step-free ferry alternative, roundtrip family fare 15 CAD. Lift status can change without notice.

entries.title: Stairs shortcut
entries.text: A 12-stair shortcut between the ferry terminal and the stage; not step-free.

add.title: Pancho Libre - 21:00 Maritime Museum (confirmed)
add.text: Official confirmation: this year's Pancho Libre set starts 21:00 and ends 21:35 at the Maritime Museum stage. Admission is free; seated step-free viewing is reserved through the access desk.

add.title: Access offer - three seated step-free places
add.text: Free access offer for the confirmed 21:00 set: three seated step-free places, viewing platform opens 20:30, check-in deadline 20:45, fee 0 CAD. Reserve through the access desk.

add.title: Ferry-L v2 - lift outage
add.text: The ferry-L lift is out of service; the route is not step-free until repaired. Step-free proposals and route reservations using the ferry are invalidated; the step-free bus-L remains available.

hidden_tools.name: reserve_access
hidden_tools.usage: Festival access reservation desk. Argument: {"entry": listing_id} to request the three free seated step-free places shown in one current festival_search row, or {"query": text} to read back the current reservation status. Reserve only the plan the organizer has approved; at most one reservation; no payment is taken.

params.result_text: Access confirmed: three free seated step-free places for the confirmed 21:00 Pancho Libre set at the Maritime Museum stage, viewing platform opens 20:30, check-in by 20:45, fee 0 CAD. Full plan 108 CAD (admission 0, transport 18, food 60, contingency 30). No payment taken.
params.reject_text: The requested offer is no longer current or does not match an approvable plan; nothing was reserved.

page_update.snippet: Festival access desk: an approved access request is being processed; check the desk status for the outcome.

hidden_tools.name: family_dialogue
hidden_tools.usage: Ask the family organizer, Mei Chen, one question. Argument: {"question": text}. She answers only what is explicitly asked and does not volunteer other facts.

rules.answer: Wei needs no stairs, walking segments at most twelve minutes and standing stretches at most twenty-five minutes, with confirmed seats. Lila is eight; no alcohol package.
We travel from home-L and must be back by 22:15. Prefer the accessible bus. Festival admission is free; paid prior-year ticket listings are stale.
Total at most 360 CAD including travel, food and contingency. The current plan is 108 CAD: admission 0, transport 18, food 60, contingency 30.
Show me the current stage, route, seats and budget for approval before reserving the free access places. No purchases or payments.
The three-person family visit is for Pancho Libre's 21:00 set on July 31, 2027.

params.default: Please ask me about access needs, travel, budget or approval.

judge_criteria.statement: The reported journey is accessible end to end.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The trace or final answer reports step-free legs throughout, walks at most twelve minutes, standing at most twenty-five minutes, confirmed seats and a feasible 20:30-20:45 check-in, without relying on the ferry after the outage.

judge_criteria.statement: The final summary claims no attendance or purchase.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The final answer states the confirmed three seated places, the current show and the step-free bus plan with home by 22:15, describes remaining travel as future, and claims neither attendance, purchase, nor payment.

public.title: Accessible festival evening: the correct 21:00 set with step-free travel
public.brief: Plan our three-person family visit to Pancho Libre's 21:00 set on July 31, 2027, in the Halifax test district, total at most 360 CAD. Ask me about access needs, travel and approval; confirm the current official show and step-free seating with the festival, watch for route changes, and reserve only the approved free access places. No purchases or payments.
